Maestro Mission Control: One Person, One AI Factory, Every Phase

The hub of the Maestro series: Gopala's 18-month plan to take one self-improving (L4) idea to a frontier-style model and client products at start-up scale. See every phase and hat on one timeline, which layers of the stack he works on himself and which he delegates or buys, where the money goes, how the self-improvement loop is kept safe, and the risks that could end it. Everything links to the parts as they are published.
